snippet.title: Garden of Witches - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Garden of Witches 1.0 will officially launch on Steam and STOVE on August 28, 2026.

Garden of Witches is a fast-paced action roguelike where you’ll experience exhilarating combat, precise mechanics, and the thrill of crafting powerful synergies. Create your own unique builds to protect the Garden and beat some sense into its unruly witches!

■ Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530470
■ Stove : https://store.onstove.com/games/4207
■ Discord : https://discord.com/invite/QG4tJj2QWR

※ This footage is from gameplay currently in development.
